independence: Personally viewed all 18 native panels with view_image at original resolution after complete source and metadata preread, before any root visual interpretation. IOP group labels, descriptions and candidate identity were visible. No clinical annotations, reader/reviewer flags or gold accessed.

group_observations.observations: All three panels show longitudinal femoral-condylar and tibial side profiles with anterior patella and posterior soft tissues. These are sagittal views, closely resembling corresponding S1 panels. The MPR/cor name alone does not describe their actual local plane; official Sagittal is supported. Similarity to S1 warrants explicit full-pixel comparison before any duplicate claim.
Six views show longitudinal knee side profiles with anterior patella, separate condylar contours and posterior structures. The Sag descriptions and official Sagittal fit local anatomy.

Six transverse sections show distal femoral cross-sections, anterior patella and posterior muscle/vascular cross-sections. S2 has a different displayed field/matrix and more slices, but the local plane is clearly axial. Tra descriptions and supplied Axial fit.

Three anterior, central and posterior coronal samples show paired femoral condyles and tibial plateau across knee width with femoral/tibial longitudinal axes. Cor description and official Coronal fit.

conclusion: All six supplied plane categories agree with native anatomy. S5 is sagittal despite cor within its MPR description; no effective plane override. Preserve source descriptions and geometry; close S1/S5 similarity requires separate full-source pixel/geometry comparison before calling duplication.
current_pipeline_implication: The loader uses official Anatomical_Plane and ignores SeriesDescription. Current routing is supported; all 298 full-source checks and six exact cache reproductions passed separately.
limitations: Eighteen selected native panels were visually reviewed; all 298 files were decoded and geometrically checked, not diagnostically interpreted.
No clinical target, true patient identity, anatomical side or report linkage inference.
MPR naming alone does not establish source-to-derived-series lineage.
No general IOP-over-description rule for other studies.
